about: When a recorded gray area matters (GR-30). Each entry points at a reading in the graph (same provision and phrase), says whether it is active, when it matters (matters_when; an unknown fact counts as 'may matter'), what each reading changes (effects; empty = not modeled: the agent reads both readings and judges whether the outcome differs), and who can settle it. A provisional reading by CC (2026-11-01) for the Portland detached-ADU slice.

ambiguities.phrase: attic area, and other building area, that is not accessible by a stairway or where the floor to ceiling height is less than 5 feet

effects.per_reading: the input gives the ADU's living area under each reading: plan.living_area_sqft.by_reading[amb id] = [reading 1, reading 2]

ambiguities.settled_by: Portland BDS (a written determination), or a Code Interpretation

ambiguities.phrase: the front building setback for the dwelling may be reduced to 10 feet

effects.note: reading 1 lets the ADU's front setback drop to 10 ft (with 220.D.4.c's height limit); reading 2 leaves the ADU on 33.205.040.C.2 (null: no change)

ambiguities.phrase: The living area of the accessory dwelling unit
A street that curves with angles that are 120 degrees or less, measured from the center line of the street

unless there are no private trees 12 inches or more in diameter, no City trees six inches or more in diameter, and/or no street trees three inches or more in diameter, and the site or activity is exempt from Section 11.50.050
The additional unit is smaller than the primary dwelling unit
ambiguities.note: Matters mainly where 33.205.040.C.1's size cap is lifted (a basement conversion); otherwise the cap keeps the ADU smaller in living area.
